title: Nancy L Probable NDE 3807
content: When I was nine my parents were divorcing. I was sent to my room and my parents were fighting. My father walked in and said, goodbye to me. As I lay there, in my bed, I became dizzy. The room started to spin, like I was inside a spin-cycle of a washing machine. The ceiling opened up and there was a tunnel reaching up to reveal several elderly men with white beards looking down at me. It was like standing at the bottom of a well looking up and then saw several people peering over the rim at you. I remember feeling that they were there to help. But, I passed out. When I woke up things were normal again. My father was gone. I would call that out of body, I am not sure. The second experience occurred when I was going through surgery, a routine procedure. The nurse was shaking me and calling my name. I did not want to return to my body. I was having the time of my life on the other side. I remember seeing the dark void of space, then seeing the earth, and it was truly brilliant from a distance. Next, I was enveloped in light. Don't remember the tunnel, just dancing light and color. I had small children and a husband but I had not been happy. I remember knowing myself completely, sensing all that was going to happen to me, being shown the future in glimpses. I was told by 'God' who was very present emotionally, but not in a body, that there were many golden opportunities ahead, and this life is a fantastic gift. I remember feeling the love and fulfillment of being with God and I did not want to leave him or this experience. I argued about leaving - I was told that God would be available to me back on earth if I asked. 'I am there too; it is you who closed the door between us.' Knowing that God would not desert me if I returned made coming back to consciousness easier.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Became dizzy and the room started to spin “like I was inside a spin-cycle of a washing machine.”

arrival.other_being_detail: “Several elderly men with white beards looking down at me,” like people peering over the rim of a well; felt they were there to help.

environment.environment_other_detail: “Dark void of space,” saw the Earth “truly brilliant from a distance,” then “enveloped in light,” with “dancing light and color.”

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Told by God that “God would be available to me back on earth if I asked” and “I am there too; it is you who closed the door between us.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two experiences were described: one at age nine during parents’ divorce conflict (passed out), and a second during a routine surgical procedure.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two separate episodes were reported: (1) childhood episode with spinning sensation, ceiling opening, tunnel-like view with elderly bearded men; (2) surgical episode with dark void/space, view of Earth, enveloping light and color, communication with God, reluctance to return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Second episode: void/space and Earth-view, then light and communication; she states she does not remember a tunnel in the second episode.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Two separate NDE-like episodes (1961 and 1981) with overlapping elements (transition/other realm, beings/light, return).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: First episode described the ceiling opening and a tunnel upward like looking up from the bottom of a well at “several elderly men with white beards” peering down.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The room started to spin, like I was inside a spin-cycle of a washing machine.” / “I was having the time of my life on the other side.” / “I am there too; it is you who closed the door between us.”
